passages.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
He gave it to the choirmaster.
The choirmaster leads music in worship.
This psalm is for public worship.

passages.text: Blessed is the one who cares for the poor; the LORD will deliver him in the day of trouble.
passages.sermon: David wrote this psalm for the choirmaster.\r\nA person who cares for the poor is blessed.\r\nThe LORD will rescue this person in times of trouble.
passages.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃ אַ֭שְׁרֵי מַשְׂכִּ֣יל אֶל־ דָּ֑ל בְּי֥וֹם רָ֝עָ֗ה יְֽמַלְּטֵ֥הוּ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: The LORD will protect and preserve him; He will bless him in the land and refuse to surrender him to the will of his foes.
passages.sermon:
The LORD will protect him.
The LORD will keep him alive.
The LORD will bless him in the land.
The LORD will not let his enemies defeat him.
The LORD will not hand him over to those who want to harm him.
passages.original: יְהוָ֤ה׀ יִשְׁמְרֵ֣הוּ וִֽ֭יחַיֵּהוּ יֶאְשֹּׁר בָּאָ֑רֶץ וְאַֽל־ תִּ֝תְּנֵ֗הוּ בְּנֶ֣פֶשׁ אֹיְבָֽיו׃

passages.text: The LORD will sustain him on his bed of illness and restore him from his bed of sickness.
passages.sermon: The LORD helps a person who is sick.\r\nThe LORD supports him when he lies on his bed in weakness.\r\nThe LORD changes his bed of sickness into a place of healing.
passages.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה יִ֭סְעָדֶנּוּ עַל־ עֶ֣רֶשׂ דְּוָ֑י כָּל־ מִ֝שְׁכָּב֗וֹ הָפַ֥כְתָּ בְחָלְיֽוֹ׃

passages.text: I said, “O LORD, be gracious to me; heal me, for I have sinned against You.”
passages.sermon:
I spoke to the LORD.
I asked the LORD to show me grace.
I asked the LORD to heal my soul.
I told the LORD that I have sinned against Him.
passages.original: אֲ‍ֽנִי־ אָ֭מַרְתִּי יְהוָ֣ה חָנֵּ֑נִי רְפָאָ֥ה נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י כִּי־ חָטָ֥אתִי לָֽךְ׃

passages.text: My enemies say with malice: “When will he die and be forgotten?”
passages.sermon:
My enemies speak with malice.
They say evil things about me.
They ask, "When will he die?"
They want me to be forgotten.
They hope my name will disappear.
passages.original: אוֹיְבַ֗י יֹאמְר֣וּ רַ֣ע לִ֑י מָתַ֥י יָ֝מ֗וּת וְאָבַ֥ד שְׁמֽוֹ׃

passages.text: My visitor speaks falsehood; he gathers slander in his heart; he goes out and spreads it abroad.
passages.sermon:
A visitor comes to see me.
He speaks lies.
He keeps false words in his heart.
He collects slander inside himself.
He leaves my house.
He spreads these lies to others.
passages.original: וְאִם־ בָּ֤א לִרְא֨וֹת׀ שָׁ֤וְא יְדַבֵּ֗ר לִבּ֗וֹ יִקְבָּץ־ אָ֥וֶן ל֑וֹ יֵצֵ֖א לַח֣וּץ יְדַבֵּֽר׃

passages.text: All who hate me whisper against me; they imagine the worst for me: “A vile disease has been poured into him; he will never get up from where he lies!”
passages.sermon:
All who hate me gather together.
They whisper about me.
They plan evil against me.
They say, “A terrible thing has happened to him.”
They say, “He will never rise again from his bed.”
passages.original: יַ֗חַד עָלַ֣י יִ֭תְלַחֲשׁוּ כָּל־ שֹׂנְאָ֑י עָלַ֓י׀ יַחְשְׁב֖וּ רָעָ֣ה לִֽי׃ דְּֽבַר־ בְּ֭לִיַּעַל יָצ֣וּק בּ֑וֹ וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁ֝כַ֗ב לֹא־ יוֹסִ֥יף לָקֽוּם׃

passages.text: Even my close friend whom I trusted, the one who shared my bread, has lifted up his heel against me.
passages.sermon:
My close friend betrayed me.
I trusted this friend.
He ate bread with me.
He turned against me.
passages.original: גַּם־ אִ֤ישׁ שְׁלוֹמִ֨י׀ אֲשֶׁר־ בָּטַ֣חְתִּי ב֭וֹ אוֹכֵ֣ל לַחְמִ֑י הִגְדִּ֖יל עָלַ֣י עָקֵֽב׃

passages.text: But You, O LORD, be gracious to me and raise me up, that I may repay them.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
I ask the LORD to show me grace.
I ask the LORD to make me strong again.
I want the LORD to help me stand up.
I will repay those who have wronged me.
passages.original: וְאַתָּ֤ה יְהוָ֗ה חָנֵּ֥נִי וַהֲקִימֵ֑נִי וַֽאֲשַׁלְּמָ֥ה לָהֶֽם׃

passages.text: By this I know that You delight in me, for my enemy does not triumph over me.
passages.sermon:
God, You delight in me.
I know this is true.
My enemy does not defeat me.
Because my enemy does not win over me, I see Your favor.
Your care for me is clear.
passages.original: בְּזֹ֣את יָ֭דַעְתִּי כִּֽי־ חָפַ֣צְתָּ בִּ֑י כִּ֤י לֹֽא־ יָרִ֖יעַ אֹיְבִ֣י עָלָֽי׃

passages.text: In my integrity You uphold me and set me in Your presence forever.
passages.sermon:
God sees my integrity.
God supports me because of my integrity.
God keeps me standing.
God places me before Him.
God keeps me in His presence forever.
passages.original: וַאֲנִ֗י בְּ֭תֻמִּי תָּמַ֣כְתָּ בִּ֑י וַתַּצִּיבֵ֖נִי לְפָנֶ֣יךָ לְעוֹלָֽם׃

passages.text: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Amen and Amen.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD deserves blessing.
The LORD exists from everlasting to everlasting.
Amen.
Amen.
passages.original: בָּ֘ר֤וּךְ יְהוָ֨ה׀ אֱלֹ֘הֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מֵֽ֭הָעוֹלָם וְעַ֥ד הָעוֹלָ֗ם אָ֘מֵ֥ן׀ וְאָמֵֽן׃
